messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Key Points** | Topic | Summary | |-------|---------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits vary by road type (e.g., 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates).
• Speed limits may be lower during construction or in school zones. | | **Seat‑belt Law** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Drivers under 18 must have a seat belt or a child safety seat. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal for drivers over 21.
• Lower BAC limits apply to commercial drivers and those under 21. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks. | | **School Bus** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading or unloading children. | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• Passing on the right is generally prohibited unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red lights mean stop; green means go (unless a sign indicates otherwise).
• Stop signs require a full stop. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or on sidewalks.
• Parking in a handicap space requires a valid permit. | | **Towing & Vehicle Registration** | • Vehicles must display a valid registration sticker.
• Towing laws require proper equipment and safe towing practices. | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for bodily injury per accident, and $25,000 for property damage. | | **Traffic Violations & Penalties** | • Fines, points on the driver’s license, and possible license suspension.
• Points accumulate over a 3‑year period; exceeding 12 points can lead to suspension. | | **Special Cases** | • Texas has specific laws for truck drivers, motorcycle riders, and commercial vehicles.
• The “Texas Highway Code” contains detailed statutes and regulations. | **Where to Find More Information** - **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website for traffic rules, road conditions, and safety programs. - **Texas Transportation Code** – Legal text detailing all traffic laws. - **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – Driver licensing, insurance, and enforcement information. If you need more specific details (e.g., how to file a traffic ticket, or the exact wording of a statute), let me know!
message.reasoning: The user wants information about traffic laws in Texas. We can provide a summary. There's no request for a lawsuit search. So we just give general info.
